exclusivity.rule: Major weapon branches are mutually exclusive and irreversible: once the player commits that weapon to one branch, the other two cannot be installed during the same run.

availability.rule: All three branches appear immediately after the weapon is equipped and require no common-ore rank, weapon level, elapsed time, or boss prerequisite.

favorable_scene_effect.qualitative: rewards remaining close to a crowd without requiring the mech to remain still

rules.text: Every valid cutter hit grants one Flywheel stack, giving +4% cutter Damage and +4% orbit speed per stack.
Stacks cap at 10, for +40% Damage and +40% orbit speed.
After 2.0 s without any cutter hit, one stack decays every 0.5 s until another valid hit lands.
The branch rewards remaining close to a crowd without requiring the mech to remain still.
